name: 3DOptix optical design and simulations
description:
3DOptix brings cloud-based optical design and simulation into Claude. Describe the system you want and Claude builds it, runs a GPU ray trace, and reads the results back to you.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Build setups from scratch or from starter templates, in millimetres or inches.
• Place and align optics, light sources and detectors by absolute pose, and reposition them without recomputing coordinates by hand.
• Search the catalog of real, orderable components — lenses, mirrors, prisms, gratings, beam splitters, apertures, windows and filters — from manufacturers including Thorlabs and Edmund Optics, filtered by focal length, diameter, material, coating and substrate.
• Add optomechanics: mounts, cages, posts and rails.
• Run GPU ray-trace simulations and get a ray table back.
• Analyse the result across the full wave-optics range: incoherent and coherent irradiance, coherent phase, Huygens and Fresnel diffraction propagation, PSF and MTF, polarised variants of each, and spectral collection — at a resolution you choose, then render the analysis as an image.
• Optimise a layout against a figure of merit with explicit free variables and constraints.
• Import existing designs — Zemax sequential files, and STEP/CAD geometry for custom parts.
• Compute optical parameters directly: effective focal length, surface radii, centre thickness, refractive index at a wavelength, and material lookup by index.

HOW IT CONNECTS

Sign in with your 3DOptix account through OAuth. There is no API key to paste and nothing to configure by hand — Claude prompts you to authorise the connection on first use, and guides you through it if anything goes wrong.

WHO IT IS FOR

Optical, photonics and laser engineers who already work in 3DOptix, and anyone prototyping an optical layout who would rather describe it than click it together.

_published_faq.name: How do I add 3DOptix optical design and simulations to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add 3DOptix optical design and simulations to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.3doptix.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the 3DOptix optical design and simulations MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: 3DOptix optical design and simulations lists 70 MCP tools, including 3doptix_analysis_delete, 3doptix_analysis_render, 3doptix_analysis_run, 3doptix_analysis_update, 3doptix_aperture_configure, 3doptix_aperture_create, 3doptix_api_healthcheck, 3doptix_build_beam_expander_lenses, 3doptix_cad_upload_and_process, 3doptix_calculate_multiplet_min_thickness, 3doptix_calculate_refractive_index, and 3doptix_client_exchange_oauth_for_api_key.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to 3DOptix optical design and simulations?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to 3DOptix optical design and simulations in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does 3DOptix optical design and simulations MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: 3DOptix optical design and simulations requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops 3DOptix optical design and simulations?

acceptedAnswer.text: 3DOptix optical design and simulations is developed by 3DOptix. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
